segments: Version scope: the following examples retain the tutorial's NixOS 24.05 context; that release is no longer maintained. Real projects should use a supported release, lock a nixpkgs revision, and check the corresponding options. system.stateVersion defines a compatibility baseline and should not be changed mechanically during upgrades. The commands in this article are teaching examples and were not run or verified on the target system.
